declarations.description:
Automatically packs direct `c2-masonry-item` children into the first available grid cells.
Use `c2-dashboard` when the application must choose fixed coordinates instead.
declarations.name: Masonry

cssParts.description: Candidate occupied area during an edit session.
cssParts.name: placeholder

members.name: editable
members.description: Shows separate move and resize controls when every tile has a unique identity.

members.name: saveLayout
members.description: Saves committed user layouts to localStorage and restores them on load. Use `save-layout="false"` to opt out.

members.name: storageKey
members.description: Optional stable localStorage key; otherwise the page URL and element ID or position identify this container.

members.name: layout
members.description: Optional application-owned saved arrangement; assignment never emits `layout-change`.

members.name: manualSlots
members.description:
Whether tiles assign their slots by hand. False only when the shadow root came from declarative shadow DOM
(server rendering), which is always in named mode; the container then falls back to `slot` attributes.

type.text: { control: HTMLElement; item: MasonryItem; action: MasonryAction } | undefined

events.name: layout-error
events.description: Invalid tile identities, spans, or supplied snapshot; does not bubble.

events.name: layout-change
events.description: Fired exactly once after a real user move or resize commit; does not bubble. Detail includes a complete restorable snapshot.

cssProperties.description: Move-handle inset from the top and right borders.
cssProperties.name: --c2-masonry-item__controls--gap

cssProperties.description: Space between the move handle and the slotted actions.
cssProperties.name: --c2-masonry-item__actions--gap

cssProperties.description: Opacity of the actions while the tile is neither hovered nor focused; 1 keeps them always visible.
cssProperties.name: --c2-masonry-item__actions--opacity

cssParts.description: Keyboard-reachable bottom edge that starts a resize operation.

cssParts.description: Pointer resize target on the right edge.

cssParts.description: Pointer resize target on the bottom-right corner; drags change columns and rows together.
cssParts.name: resize-corner

slots.description: Optional move-handle icon; an inline grip is provided by default.
slots.name: move-icon

slots.description: Buttons for the tile, such as a menu, in its top-right corner after the move handle. They show with the move handle, while the tile is hovered or has focus (see `--c2-masonry-item__actions--opacity`), and work whether or not the container is `editable`. Put them on the item itself, beside its content, so a tile whose content is one link can still carry a menu.
slots.name: actions

members.description: Stable identity used for editing and application snapshots.

members.name: label
members.description: Human-readable name used for the scroll region and edit controls.

members.name: rows
members.description: Positive integer row span shared across size ranges.

members.name: colsXs
members.description: Optional positive column span for containers narrower than 600 px.

members.name: colsSm
members.description: Optional positive column span for 600–959.99 px containers.

members.name: colsMd
members.description: Optional positive column span for 960–1279.99 px containers.

members.name: colsLg
members.description: Optional positive column span for containers at least 1280 px wide.

members.name: moveHandle
members.description:
Id of an element inside the tile that moves it, in place of the built-in move handle, which is then not drawn: a
button in the tile's own header, for example. Pressing it, or Enter or Space on it, starts a move exactly as on
the built-in handle. The element is the application's: label it ("Move Groceries"), show it only while the
container is `editable` if it should not show otherwise, and give it `touch-action: none` so a touch drag moves the
tile instead of scrolling the page. The resize edges stay as they are.

members.name: pinned
members.description:
Keeps the tile in the group at the start of the container: pinned tiles always come before the others, in their
own order. A move keeps a pinned tile among the pinned ones and any other tile after them, and a pinned tile
authored or restored after an unpinned one is placed before it. Pin a tile the application keeps in view, such as a
pinned note; nothing about the look changes, so show the pin in the tile itself.
